{{Top|leg}}
[[File:TogrutaSash-TCWLD.png|thumb|right|250px|Ahsoka's sash]]

The '''Togruta sash''' was a traditional piece of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] worn by numerous members of the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TCW" /><ref name="{{Film|II}}">{{Film|II}}</ref>

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] wore a Togruta sash hanging from her belt during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TCW">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> as did [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], incorporated into their traditional [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]]. Most Togruta sashes were a dull [[Color/Legends|color]] and had darker swirling or decorative patterns that adorned the whole sash.

Many other Togrutas wore this clothing item throughout the war.<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref><ref name="Slaves of the Republic">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref><ref name="The Gathering">[[Gathering (20 BBY)|''The Gathering (Clone Wars)'']]</ref>
